GitHub CLI.notes: Every helper and routine reads GitHub with gh; bot-gh wraps it with an app token.

Claude Code.notes: Runs every routine. Its skills, plugins and scheduled tasks are the attack surface of an unattended run.

jq.notes: Parses GitHub and feed JSON in the helpers.

curl.notes: Talks to GitHub, Telegram, OSV, NVD and CISA in the helpers.

OpenSSL.notes: bot-gh signs the GitHub App token with openssl.
